logout.title: Sign out
logout.body: Are you sure you want to sign out?

totp.disabledBody: Add a second step to every sign-in: a 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Without it, your account stays protected by password only.
totp.enabledBody: Every sign-in now requires a 6-digit code from your authenticator app. If you lose your device, use one of your backup codes.

disable.dialogBody: Your account will only be protected by your password until you turn it back on. You will need to re-scan the QR code if you re-enable it later.

totp.reauthRequired: Your sign-in is older than 5 minutes. Sign out and sign in again to continue.

step1.heading: Scan with your authenticator app
step1.instruction1: Open Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or any TOTP app.
step1.instruction2: Scan the QR code on the left.
step1.instruction3: Type the 6-digit code your app shows below.
step1.manualEntryDisclosure: Can't scan? Enter this key manually

errors.invalidCode: That code didn't match. Try the next one your app shows.
errors.noEnrollmentInProgress: Something went wrong. Click Restart to begin again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

step2.heading: Save your backup codes
step2.body: If you lose access to your authenticator app, use one of these codes to sign in. Each code works once.
step2.warning: These codes will not be shown again.
step2.confirmCheckboxLabel: I've saved my backup codes somewhere safe

cancelAlert.title: Leave without saving?
cancelAlert.body: You're already enrolled but haven't saved backup codes. They won't be shown again. You can regenerate them from the Security page.

step3.heading: Two-factor sign-in is on
step3.bodyHeading1: From now on, every sign-in needs:
step3.bodyItem1b: A 6-digit code from your authenticator app
step3.bodyItem2a: Use one of your backup codes
step3.bodyItem2b: Then regenerate codes from this page

regenerate.dialogBody: This invalidates your existing backup codes. Make sure you can scan a fresh QR or have your phone.
regenerate.successHeading: Here are your new backup codes
regenerate.successBody: Your old codes are no longer valid. Save these somewhere safe.

reenrol.body_one: You signed in with a backup code. You have {{count}} code left. Re-enrol your authenticator app to restore normal sign-in.
reenrol.body_other: You signed in with a backup code. You have {{count}} codes left. Re-enrol your authenticator app to restore normal sign-in.

regenerate.body_one: You're running low on backup codes — {{count}} left. Generate a new set so you're covered if you lose your device.
